citations.claim: initial position just to right of wall, distance_to_surface 0.1
after one step body centre has passed through wall to opposite side, violating no_tunneling

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0319 to 0.001 (only dt field changed), keeping steps=1 and all other fields identical; smaller timestep reduces per-substep displacement below wall thickness so CCD/collision prevents tunneling.

explanation: Body starts 0.1m from thin wall (w=0.2) with high velocity (~55.6 m/s, vx=-33.1, vy=-44.6) and dt=0.032. Displacement between steps (~1.06m in x) exceeds wall thickness, so centre crosses through wall box between steps 0 and 1. Substep count 60 insufficient and CCD/tunneling check fails to prevent crossing. Reducing dt to 0.001 (smaller displacement per substep) avoids tunneling.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 0 and 1

vision_note: In tile 0 the red body is immediately to the right of the thin vertical grey wall. In tile 1 it has jumped to the bottom tip on/through the wall, no longer on the right side, showing a discontinuous crossing of the wall between consecutive steps.
